legacy_payload_safety.evidence: Existing nested schedule, node execution, and raw ops can remain supported.

conflict_risk.evidence: Flat fields can conflict with nested fields unless validated.

typed_ops_safety.evidence: nodeexec typed ops have strict white-lists that must not be bypassed.

findings.summary: Flat and nested fields must either agree or fail fast.
Flat apply_ops generation must produce the same typed wire shape accepted by nodeexec.Ops.
